title: Odd-degree closed-left-half-plane endpoint inequality

statement.quantifiers: EVERY real polynomial p(z)=sum_(j=0)^d a_j z^j of ODD degree d with a_0,a_d>0 and no root in Re z>0.
statement.assertion: a_0 a_d<=a_1 a_(d-1). Middle coefficient sign assumption unnecessary. Multiplicities and imaginary-axis roots allowed. This endpoint inequality is established prior in cited Anari et al. Lemma 28/Asner mechanism according to source; exact imported original theorem was not reopened in this extraction.
assumptions: Odd actual degree, real coefficients, positive nonzero endpoints, closed left-half-plane roots.

outputs: Endpoint coefficient comparison usable after stable univariate reduction.
interface.precision: Exact polynomial identity; no strict-stability perturbation needed.
costs: Analytic lemma; does not provide counting, sampler transitions or a numerical root certificate.

proof_mechanism: Conjugate root pairs contribute nonnegative real parts to sum r_i and sum 1/r_i.
Odd degree forces a nonempty positive real-root reciprocal set; Cauchy-Schwarz gives product >=1.
obstructions: Even-degree p=1+z² defeats conclusion; oddness is load-bearing.
Do not present alternate elementary proof as a new inequality.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Ensure transformed polynomial has odd actual degree and correct endpoint coefficients.

review.source_reported: Internal analytic audits or released-source proof only; exact reported scopes retained in cited source. No scientific suite or formal kernel replay in this extraction.
